understanding.goal_understanding: Navigate the grid to complete each level by activating all goal cells. A goal cell is completed only when the carried piece matches that goal’s required shape, color, and rotation at the same time, and you step onto the goal tile. Completing all goals advances the level; completing all levels wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you choose a movement action (north/south/east/west). Movement can be blocked by walls, leaving position unchanged while still costing stamina. The carried piece has three attributes—shape, color, and rotation—and special modifier tiles on the grid change these attributes when stepped on: shape modifiers cycle the shape, color modifiers cycle the color, and rotation modifiers rotate the piece 90° clockwise. The UI indicates what aspect(s) don’t match a goal and may point to relevant modifier tile locations. Stamina decreases with actions; if it reaches zero you lose a life and stamina resets. Losing all lives ends the game.
